issues.issue: Federal Grants Fund budget schedule: printed total expenditures (detail_totals[5] = 51,386,753) is $1 less than the sum of its printed lines (51,386,754). The cause is the General Government subtotal on p7: 271,463 + 125 + 2,985,922 = 3,257,510, but 3,257,509 is printed. The detail items are transcribed correctly, but this report discrepancy (difference -1, p8) is not recorded in report_discrepancies, unlike the matching General Fund and Street Construction rounding entries.

The label says 'Reimbursement' and the rules give reimbursements their own category (reimbursements/refunds). charges for services/fees is defensible because these are payments for services the city provides, but it is a judgment call. The same applies to detail[6] (General, 5,877,792), detail[42] (Street Construction, 5,332) and detail[58] (Federal Grants, 1,062,747), all detail_category 'other charges for services'.

Capital outlay detail lines are categorized inconsistently. The Street Construction line uses category 'capital outlay'. The Federal Grants capital outlay lines (detail[69], [73], [77], [82]) and the nonmajor capital projects lines (detail[132]-[140]) use the function (public safety, streets/highways...). All use detail_category 'not itemized', although capital outlay is an object, so construction/infrastructure or equipment purchases could apply. The amounts are correct.
